field.name: exEntityID
field.comment: The ID of the Express entity the entry belongs to (it's not used when entryMode is A, since the attribute knows the entity)

field.name: exSpecificEntryID
field.comment: The ID of the entry to be displayed (used if entryMode is S)

field.name: exEntryAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the Express attribute of the page holding the entry to be displayed (used if entryMode is A)

field.name: exFormID
field.comment: The ID of the form of the Express entity that renders the entry

field.name: entryMode
field.comment: E: the entry comes from the list block of another page; S: it's the one in exSpecificEntryID; A: it's the one held by the page attribute named by exEntryAttributeKeyHandle
